name: How quickly does mold grow after a water leak?

mainEntity.name: How quickly does mold grow after a water leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold can begin to grow within 24 to 48 hours after a water leak introduces moisture to organic materials. Optimal conditions for mold include dampness, warmth, and a food source like wood, drywall, or fabric. Visible mold might take a few days to appear, but spores can germinate quickly in hidden areas. Prompt water removal and drying are crucial to prevent or minimize mold growth following any water damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold can start growing within 24 to 48 hours after a water leak, given the right conditions. Immediate drying is essential to prevent its spread.
